tax.text: Mannion says the wealthiest Americans should pay more so government can keep investing in communities.
tax.quote: The wealthiest Americans in the billionaire class should pay their fair share in taxes so the federal government can continue to invest in our communities.

debt.text: Mannion voted against the GOP budget bill, opposing its cuts to health care and food assistance.
debt.quote: it will take away food assistance from kids and seniors, strip health care from the disabled and most vulnerable, and saddle the nation with trillions of dollars of new debt.

schools.text: Mannion calls for increasing federal funding for public schools rather than diverting it.
schools.quote: Increasing federal funding for public schools to reduce class sizes, improve facilities, and provide essential resources for students and teachers.

immigration.text: Mannion refuses to approve added ICE funding and demands guardrails on enforcement.
immigration.quote: I won't rubberstamp billions of additional taxpayers' dollars to reinforce ICE

guns.text: Mannion backs enhanced background-check legislation to tighten gun laws.
guns.quote: John is supporting legislation like the Enhanced Background Checks Act of 2025 to provide common sense measures to reform our gun laws.

health.text: Mannion supports a universal public health insurance option and expanding Medicare and Medicaid.
health.quote: There should be a universal public healthcare option.

energy.text: Mannion supports continued reductions in greenhouse gas emissions and a transition to renewable energy.
energy.quote: Continuing American leadership in reducing greenhouse gas emissions and protecting communities from severe weather events.

voting.text: Mannion opposed the SAVE Act, defending mail-in voting and disputing claims of noncitizen voting.
voting.quote: It's about ending mail-in ballots. The president has voted by mail. American citizens are the ones voting in these elections.

tax.text: Buller, a self-described fiscal conservative, argues New York's high taxes are driving residents and revenue out and calls for lowering the tax burden.
tax.quote: New York State is the highest taxed state in the nation and as a result has lost over 500,000 residents and over $10 billion in tax revenue in just one year alone.

debt.text: Buller says Social Security and Medicare benefits earned by seniors who paid in must be honored.
debt.quote: Central New York seniors have spent their entire working lives paying into these programs — and they have earned every dollar of those benefits.

housing.text: Buller supports encouraging development and cutting regulations to make homeownership more attainable for first-time buyers.
housing.quote: She supports policies that encourage responsible development, cut unnecessary regulations, and make it easier for first-time buyers to enter the market.

safety.text: Buller backs law enforcement and opposes cashless bail and efforts to defund the police.
safety.quote: Kailee strongly opposes cashless bail policies and any effort to defund the police.

immigration.text: Buller calls for comprehensive immigration reform with legal farm-labor pathways while insisting criminals be removed, a mixed position.
immigration.quote: We need to make sure that the labor that we bring in is legitimate but also that those who are criminals are out of our country.

health.text: Buller favors market-oriented health reforms, including expanding Health Savings Accounts and competition to lower costs.

energy.text: Buller wants to repeal state climate mandates and pursue an all-of-the-above energy approach to lower prices and protect reliability.
energy.quote: she supports repealing those costly climate mandates and advancing an all-of-the-above energy policy
